objective: Review concurrency, identity, ownership, public errors and cache/checkpoint interactions independently.
reviewer: independent reviewer agent, fresh context, not implementation owner of BATCH_EXEC or CACHE_GRAPH

findings.title: Resume-after-finalize silently overwrites the published composite with a single-row rebuild
findings.suggested_disposition: re-fold all committed captures before re-finalizing on resume, or refuse loudly; add tamper+composite+resume regression test

findings.title: Composite artifacts have no integrity verification on resume when no row re-runs
findings.suggested_disposition: journal + digest-verify composite artifacts, or always re-export from journal captures on resume

findings.title: Staged-artifact integrity failures raise BatchCancelledError (cancel/corruption conflation, no row attribution)
findings.suggested_disposition: raise a dedicated integrity error carrying row index (InvariantViolation with row=i)

findings.title: Checkpoint error literal references non-existent load_resume()
findings.suggested_disposition: point to the real resume entry (re-run RunBatch with the same checkpoint directory)

findings.title: Publication is neither fsynced nor generation-atomic (journal writes are; recovery exists via resume digest verification)
findings.suggested_disposition: fsync published files + parent dir at commit, or document the crash window next to dossier 05

findings.title: Resume replaces una.topology/una.accessibility/una.flow object identities as a consistent bundle (serial mutates in place)
findings.suggested_disposition: document in dossier 05; no code change

findings.title: _ResultChannel.get depends on private mp.SimpleQueue._poll (verified on CPython 3.11.4)
findings.suggested_disposition: compat shim or documented poll mechanism

findings.title: Residual: worker death between put() and get() can surface bare EOFError; never escaped in probes (any_dead() cancel path converts to BatchCancelledError)
findings.suggested_disposition: record as residual risk; no change now

findings.title: cache/identity.py NaN-scalar docstring overclaims (implementation + reviewed test pin one-canonical-tag intent)
